results.title: United na harin Bassey da Collins, AC Milan na zawarcin Endrick

results.title: Me ya sa jam'iyyu masu mulki ke faɗuwa zabe a kasashen duniya?
results.content: A 'yan shekarun nan, jam'iyyun da suka daɗe suna mulki sun fuskanci babban ƙalubale daga masu zaɓe. Wasu sun rasa mulki, yayin da wasu kuma suka rasa rinjayensu a majalisun dokoki.
